description: This file defines Express route handlers related to user session management, including endpoints for listing associated tenants, setting active tenants, and toggling global tenant scope. It incorporates middleware for authentication and authorization, interacts with models for audit logging, and documents routes with Swagger comments.

methods.name: /api/session/tenants [GET]
methods.description: Returns a list of tenants associated with the current authenticated user, with audit logging.

methods.name: /api/session/tenant [POST]
methods.description: Sets the active tenant in session or cookie after RBAC validation, with audit logging.

methods.name: /api/tenants/select [POST]
methods.description: Alias for /api/session/tenant to select an active tenant.

methods.name: /api/session/all-tenants [POST]
methods.description: Enables or disables global tenant scope mode for super admins, with audit logging.
